name: o58320

schema.title: JSON schema for Web Application manifest files (schema extensions)

mjs_access_whitelist.description: The mjs_access_whitelist member is an array of rules that indicates the type of access the URLs matching the rule should have.

url.description: A string that represents the URL pattern for which the rule should be applied to.

apiAccess.description: A string that defines the type of access to the runtime API where the application is running.

description: The current access whitelist for the application defines three URL patterns and their associated runtime‑API permissions. Requests that match `https://api.example.com/v1/*` are granted full API access (`all`). Requests to `https://static.example.com/assets/*` are permitted only for web‑only API calls (`AllowForWebOnly`). Finally, any request targeting `https://internal.example.local/health` receives no API access (`none`).
